### Borea v0.6.20

A patch release with links that set up an instance from a list of mods. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### New

- A `borea://modlist` link creates a new instance with an exact list of mods, for example the mods of a multiplayer server. Borea shows every mod with its version first and installs nothing until you click Create. Your other instances stay as they are.
- A mod in such a link that Borea cannot install, because it is not in the content index, is yanked or does not fit your game, is marked with the reason.

#### For mod and server authors

- The link is `borea://modlist?mods=ModA@1.2.0,ModB@0.4.1&name=Server+Name`. Every entry is a content index id with an exact version. The name is optional, and so is an `id` such as `&id=my-server` that names the list. If a link is not valid, Borea says why.

#### Changes

- The dialogs that import a modlist or duplicate an instance have a new layout, with the name field on its own line and Create at the bottom.

Full changelog: [v0.6.19...v0.6.20](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.19...v0.6.20)
